name: First screen: the promise, the caveat under it, three doors with one primary button each, secondary link and wallet line
Doors route to the call flow, the thesis flow and the connected wallet profile
One call flow: defaults, visible fields, one button, advanced behind More, trade-it-too on when the wallet holds IMD
Trade it too off posts just the call through router.note with an exact 0.6 IMD approval to the router
Trade it too on keeps the exact combined 1.6 IMD approval and tradeAndNote
Trade it too defaults off when the wallet holds no IMD; token from the URL wins over the last token
Baseline rule is explained where it bites: warm-up with countdown, ready, and the warm-up button
Thesis flow states the 7-day child rule before the bond and again on the receipt with the button
Profile page: wallet, hit rate large, counts, score meaning, open/settled/theses, backers, share card and the Pages panel
Own profile shows Your pages and earnings; Feedback opens from the footer and the old tab link
Every v4 route reflows at 320 and 390 in dark mode with focus visible
